reason: Two full-screen terminal quirks with no GUI counterpart: in a multi-select picker Space always toggled the row, so a search could not contain a space, and a command typed while the previous one was finishing was dropped because no prompt was waiting yet. Space now toggles only while the search is empty and otherwise types into it; an entry submitted while a step is still running is kept as typed-ahead input, shown in the footer, sent when the shell next prompts, and returned to the composer by Ctrl-C. Selected: the new input unit suite (Space in a filtered and unfiltered picker, typed-ahead submit, Ctrl-C), the TUI suite for the full-screen client, a real-Core PTY journey on a paired TLS LAN Core (two commands typed in one burst both run; a bulk chat picker still toggles with Space), the product-knowledge search and Chroma digest sync, and the settings-catalog terminal test.
exclusions: No full suites. No native or Playwright changes: only the separate Python terminal client, docs and settings catalog keywords changed, and the catalog change is covered by its Vitest file. tests/test_terminal_pty.py and tests/v3/test_terminal_core.py are not selected because several of them fail identically on pristine origin/main; they were run locally against a merge of the round-2 terminal branches and against pristine origin/main; the same tests failed on both, apart from two intermittent ones described in the PR (one of which also fails intermittently on main). No live provider calls or Core deployment.
